camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise RegisterInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceSource RDS --Port 3306 --DatabasePassword Example_passw0rd --Host '172.XX.XXX.254' --SafeRule test_rule --ExportTimeout 600 --EnvType product --NetworkType VPC --InstanceAlias test_instance --DbaUid 222754820727870000 --DatabaseUser dmstest --InstanceType MySQL --QueryTimeout 60
description_en: Registers a new database instance in DMS
description_zh: 在DMS中录入新的数据库实例
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise register-instance --instance-type MySQL --instance-source RDS --network-type VPC --env-type product --host 172.XX.XXX.254 --port 3306 --database-user dmstest --database-password Example_passw0rd --instance-alias test_instance --dba-uid 222754820727870000 --safe-rule test_rule --query-timeout 60 --export-timeout 600 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterInstance

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The database type. For valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据库类型，取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the database instance. Valid values:

PUBLIC_OWN: self-managed instance connected over the Internet
RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance
ECS_OWN: self-managed instance hosted on an ECS instance
VPC_IDC: self-managed instance in a VPC-connected IDC
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例来源，取值如下：

PUBLIC_OWN：代表公网自建实例
RDS：代表RDS实例
ECS_OWN：代表ECS自建实例
VPC_IDC：代表VPC IDC自建实例
parameters.name: instance_source

parameters.help_en:
The network type. Valid values:

CLASSIC: classic network
VPC: VPC
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，取值如下：

CLASSIC：经典网络
VPC：VPC网络
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en:
The environment type. Valid values:
product: production environment
dev: development environment
pre: staging environment
test: test environment
sit: SIT environment
uat: UAT environment
pet: stress testing environment
stag: STAG environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境类型，取值如下：
product：生产环境
dev：开发环境
pre：预发环境
test：测试环境
sit：SIT环境
uat：UAT环境
pet：压测环境
stag：STAG环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The ECS instance ID.

This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to ECS_OWN
parameters.help_zh:
ECS的实例ID。

如果InstanceSource取值为ECS_OWN，此值必填
parameters.name: ecs_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID.

This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to VPC_IDC
parameters.help_zh:
VPC ID。

如果InstanceSource取值为VPC_IDC时，此值必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the instance resides.

This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to RDS, ECS_OWN, or VPC_IDC
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在区域。

如果InstanceSource取值为RDS、ECS_OWN或VPC_IDC，此值必填
parameters.name: ecs_region

parameters.help_en: The host address of the destination database
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据库的主机地址
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The access port of the destination database
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据库的访问端口
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The SID of the database.

This parameter is required if InstanceType is set to ORACLE
parameters.help_zh:
数据库SID。

如果InstanceType为ORACLE，此项必填
parameters.name: sid

parameters.help_en: The username used to access the database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库访问账号
parameters.name: database_user

parameters.help_en: The password used to access the database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库访问密码
parameters.name: database_password

parameters.help_en: The alias of the instance. This alias helps you quickly identify and locate the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例别名，可以帮助用户快速区分定位实例
parameters.name: instance_alias

parameters.help_en: The UID of the user who assumes the DBA role for the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 实例DBA角色的用户UID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dba_uid

parameters.help_en: The security rule set (GroupName) of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/417891.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 实例的安全规则集（GroupName），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/417891.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: safe_rule

parameters.help_en: The query timeout period. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询超时时间，单位：s（秒）
parameters.name: query_timeout

parameters.help_en: The export timeout period. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 导出超时时间，单位：s（秒）
parameters.name: export_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The name of the datalink for cross-database query.

This parameter is required if UseDsql is set to 1.
The datalink name can only contain lowercase letters and underscores (_).
The datalink name must be globally unique within the tenant
parameters.help_zh:
输入跨库查询datalink名称。

如果UseDsql取值为1，此值必填。
DBLink名称只能使用小写字母和下划线（_）。
DBLink名称需要在租户内保持全局唯一性
parameters.name: data_link_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether schema evolution is prioritized. Valid values:
0: not used
1: native lock-free takes priority, falling back to execute in DMS if failed
2: execute via DMS lock-free

Supported database types: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, PolarDB for MySQL engine, ApsaraDB MyBase for MySQL, and MySQL databases from other sources
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启结构变更优先，取值如下：
0 ：不使用
1 ：原生无锁优先，失败转DMS执行
2 ：DMS无锁变更执行

支持的数据库类型：RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL引擎、MyBase MySQL、其他来源MySQL
parameters.name: ddl_online

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-instance query. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled

Supported database types: MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle), and Redis
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用跨实例查询，取值如下：
0：不开启
1：开启

支持的数据库类型：MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、Redis
parameters.name: use_dsql

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the instance ignores the connectivity test. Valid values:
true: ignored
false: not ignored
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否忽略测试连通性。取值如下：
true：忽略
false：不忽略
parameters.name: skip_test

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable sensitive data protection. Valid values:
Y: enables sensitive data protection
NULL or other values: disables sensitive data protection
parameters.help_zh:
Y：开启敏感数据保护
NULL或其它：不开启敏感数据保护
parameters.name: enable_sell_sitd

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classification template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The classification template type. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板类型。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460613.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The string used to replace the DbaUid field. You can enter a non-numeric DBA UID, such as a role account
parameters.help_zh: 用于替换DbaUid字段，可输入角色账号等非数字DbaUid
parameters.name: dba_uid_by_string

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group to which the instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
